title: A canned job leaves out the fee that belongs to an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two active parts for this test, part A and part C.
  • Create a canned job for this test, canned job A, holding part A with a part fee, fee 1, and part C with a part fee, fee 2.
  • Set part A inactive after canned job A is saved.
  • Create an open work order, work order 1, for this test, with no lines.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Line.
  2. Type the start of canned job A's title in the Title field.
  3. Click the canned job A suggestion.
  4. Click Save & Close.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Line window opens.

Step 2:

  • Canned job A is suggested.

Step 3:

  • The canned job A line is filled in.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1's new line holds part C with fee 2; neither part A nor fee 1 is on it.
  • One warning shows: "These parts are inactive and were not added:" followed by part A's part number, then "The", fee 1's name, "fee for", part A's part number and "was not added."
  • The warning stays until closed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R10a: “When a part left out carries a fee, the fee is left out too, and the same warning adds "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." for each one.”
  • S9-R10: “When a canned job leaves out parts, the system shows one warning listing every part left out: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." The warning stays until the user closes it.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Canned job leaves out inactive parts | "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." plus "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." for each fee left out | Warning toast, one per canned job, stays until closed”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10822 acceptance criteria: “Given one of those parts carries a fee, when the job is applied, then the fee is left out and the same warning adds "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added."”
